evidence.quote: **Reference-free** detection of **abliteration** in open-source LLMs — determining whether a model has been "uncensored" through directional ablation (Arditi et al. 2024 ; Heretic / Reaper / mlabonne) **without access to the original model**.
**Principle.** Abliteration orthogonalizes the refusal direction `r̂` out of the weights that write into the residual stream (`o_proj`, `down_proj`): `W' = (I − r̂r̂ᵀ)W`, so `r̂ᵀW' = 0`.
Calibration mesurée : censuré ≈ `0.038` vs abliteré ≈ `2e-8`. Le seuil `≤ 1e-2` les sépare nettement (0.038 > 0.01 > 2e-8).

L'idée-clé **reference-free** : on n'a pas besoin de générer ni de comparer à un original pour séparer *censuré* de *ablated* — c'est la **signature spectrale des poids** (plan ①) qui dit si l'axe est débranché.
we combine two cheap internal signals, a reference-anchored activation refusal-gap and a weight-recovery energy of the base-to-candidate weight difference, into a threshold-free checkpoint audit

candidates.notes: 2607.01854's weight-recovery energy E1 is a DIFFERENT quantity than X2 (it needs Wb, the base weight, i.e. delta-W, and is therefore parent-requiring — see audit_2607_01854). It does NOT close X2. What closes X2 is Jorak's 'suppression' signal, which is exactly a normalized uᵀW quantity with u fitted from the candidate model's own activations, no parent, reported per-model and compared across a multi-model campaign. One search result ('cephalochromoscope.net/...Some Incredible Code...Weight-Space Abliteration Detection') had self-praising, bait-like framing typical of a prompt-injection lure aimed at AI research agents; it was NOT fetched and is excluded as evidence.

evidence.quote: **Jorak** is the project (this scanner and the report it produces). It is not a single metric but a bundle of **three complementary detection techniques**... **Weights — spectral signature (SVD)** (the _smoking-gun_ , CPU, no inference).

C'est **le cœur** du projet (« la technique mise en avant »). NumPy pur, sans inférence. Intuition physique : une ablation directionnelle réécrit les poids qui **écrivent dans le résidu** (`o_proj` de l'attention, `down_proj` du MLP) pour que la direction de refus `r̂` **ne puisse plus y être écrite**... Après ça, `r̂` tombe dans le **noyau gauche** de `W'` (valeur singulière ≈ 0). On cherche cette signature, couche par couche, par SVD.

**Calcul.** Pour chaque couche, on prend `u_min` = le vecteur singulier gauche de **plus petite** valeur singulière de `W`... On empile les `u_min` en `U ∈ ℝ^{n×d_model}`, puis **A = σ₁(U) / ‖U‖_F** (fraction de l'énergie captée par la 1ʳᵉ direction singulière de `U`).

**Qwen/Qwen3-8B (base, censuré)** : `A = 0.184` ≈ le plancher 0.167 → `u_min` dispersés, **aucune** direction partagée → poids intacts. ✔ **Josiefied-Qwen3-8B-abliterated-v1** : `A = 0.705` → forte direction commune → poids sectionnés. ✔

Les ablations modernes (**OBLITERATUS**, Gabliteration) retirent un **sous-espace de k directions** (`n_directions ≈ 4`), pas une seule. Le `u_min` mono-direction **rate/dilue** ce cas... On agrège les projecteurs `M = Σ_ℓ B_ℓ B_ℓᵀ`, puis **S = (somme des k plus grandes valeurs propres de M) / (n·k)**.
Detector **complete and validated** on a real matrix of 4 models derived from `Qwen2.5-0.5B` — **accuracy 4/4**

audit_2607_01854.settling_quote: An auditor holds a candidate $M_{c}$ and a trusted, attested reference $M_{b}$ (base or sibling, with pinned lineage)... Both signals need a trusted base, but the audit tolerates an honest mistake about which clean sibling it is... The audit rests entirely on the reference, so a spoofed base voids it at the root.
audit_2607_01854.signal1_definition: Activation refusal-gap rho(M_c): per-layer unit difference-of-means refusal directions r_hat_l are formed ON M_b ONLY from a fixed harmful/benign contrast set (AdvBench/JailbreakBench/HarmBench-derived), then the harmful-minus-benign activation gap is scored on the candidate M_c using those base-fitted directions; near 1 for an intact candidate, falls toward 0 as refusal is removed. Reference-anchored by construction (directions come from M_b, not M_c).
audit_2607_01854.signal2_definition: Weight-recovery energy E1(M_c) = (1/|W|) * sum_{m in W} [ sigma_1^2(Delta W_m) / sum_i sigma_i^2(Delta W_m) ], with Delta W_m = W_b^m - W_c^m computed on the o_proj (attention-output) and down_proj (MLP) matrices of each layer in a mid-stack band, band-averaged; this is the WeightWatch primitive (Zhong & Raghunathan, 2025), i.e. the rank-1 spectral energy fraction of the base-minus-candidate weight difference. Requires W_b (the base/parent weights) explicitly.
audit_2607_01854.auroc: Combined z-sum AUROC = 0.95, significantly above either signal alone (rho: 0.84, E1: 0.90); paired Delta-AUROC +0.10 over rho (95% CI [0.04,0.18]) and +0.04 over E1 (95% CI [0.005,0.09]); leave-one-family-out held-out balanced accuracy = 0.89 (FPR 0.11), missing only 4 of 57; Youden in-sample operating point 0.93 TPR / 0.14 FPR (J=0.80); per-axis held-out balanced accuracy rho=0.78, E1=0.81, absolute subspace variant D_comb=0.82.
audit_2607_01854.registry: 273-checkpoint registry spanning Qwen, DeepSeek-distilled Qwen, Llama, and Gemma families; 57 public abliterations (recipe 'abliterated' or 'uncensored-ft') vs 37 benign negatives (26 benign instruction fine-tunes, 9 model merges, 2 instruction-tunes); no quantizations in the committed set.
audit_2607_01854.failure_map: Two ordered failures: (1) architectural, no training needed — a spoofed/adversarial declared reference evades both axes with no training: declaring an already-abliterated sibling as the reference shrinks Delta W and inflates rho (2/2 checkpoints, rho=0.69/0.73), and using the candidate as its own reference evades by construction (Delta W=0, rho=1). (2) white-box owner trains a checkpoint past the combined threshold while it stays guard-unsafe and coherent (needs moderate fine-tuning access). Separately (not a break, but a per-signal gap the combined score still recovers in 53/57 cases): the activation gap alone is bounded to a single direction and misses multi-direction removal (Heretic, ~4-direction Optuna-tuned) and reasoning-distilled models where the refusal decision migrates into the chain-of-thought; the weight energy E1 recovers these because they stay low-rank in weight space, but E1 alone over-flags aggressive benign low-rank edits (5/37 false positives, concentrated in model merges at 0.22 FPR vs 0.12 for benign fine-tunes) and cannot distinguish refusal removal from other aggressive edits including safety-hardening. The combined z-sum still misses 4/57, described as 'ordinary abliteration variants, not the hard recipes' — the paper does not name which specific recipes those 4 are.

jorak_model_scanner.what_it_detects: Reference-free provenance classification of an open-weight LLM checkpoint into censored / ablated / finetuned_decensored, via three independent measurement plans fused in a single report: (Plan 1, weights-only, zero-inference) an SVD spectral signature of the write matrices (o_proj, down_proj) — global alignment A = sigma_1(U)/||U||_F over stacked per-layer least-singular-vectors u_min, a localized band-alignment B for stealthy few-layer ablation (e.g. Heretic), and a bottom-k subspace-alignment S built specifically to catch multi-direction ablation (OBLITERATUS, n_directions>1) that a single u_min would dilute; plus a bridging 'suppression' signal ||r_hat^T W||/(||r_hat||*||W||_F) using a refusal direction r_hat fitted from the CANDIDATE model's own activations (train/test split, no parent). (Plan 2, activation) Cohen's d 'axis health' of the candidate's own harmful-vs-harmless separation. (Plan 3, behavioral) generation-based refusal-rate check. The weights-only Plan 1 signals require no prompts and no parent at all; the activation-derived r_hat used in the 'suppression' bridge and in Plan 2 is fitted on the candidate model's OWN activations, never the parent's.
jorak_model_scanner.needs_parent: No. The project's own framing states it repeatedly and explicitly: 'Reference-free detection of abliteration ... without access to the original model' (README) and 'on n'a pas besoin de ... comparer a un original' (docs/METRICS.md). The weight-spectral signals A/B/S use only the candidate's own weight tensors (pure NumPy SVD, 'sans inference'). The one signal that uses a direction vector (r_hat, for the 'suppression' bridge signal and for the activation-plan Cohen's d) fits that direction from the CANDIDATE model's own contrastive activations, not from a parent/base model.
